body:
v4.0 Breaking (owner: "Yes, default in v4.0"). Remembered empty named graphs, opt-in since the earlier #400 work, become the default for mutable datasets and SPARQL Update: CREATE registers an empty graph, and DROP or CLEAR follow the remembered semantics. Any opt-out must be an explicit caller choice.

Cover Rust, the CLI, Python, C and wasm, the governor and update tests, the CHANGELOG Breaking section and the book (with zh-Hans). Tests must fail before the change, and each needs a valid neighbour. Refs #400.
title: v4.0: remembered empty named graphs become the default
